[B1] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
[B3] < deviceB | 'online' : false , 'key' : Key , ... > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB
=> < deviceB | 'online' : true , 'key' : Key , ... > $ deviceB 'sendKey' UserX | (Key) .
[B3] < UserX | 'key' : nils , ... > $ deviceB 'sendKey' UserX | (Key)
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > .
[B4] < cloudA | deviceB : ('owner' : nils , 'bindingKey' : Key , ...) , ... > < deviceB | 'online' : true , ... > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (Key)
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('owner' : UserX , 'bindingKey' : Key , ...) , ... > < deviceB | 'online' : true , ... > .
[B5] < cloudA | deviceB : ('owner' : UserX , ...) , ... > < deviceB | 'online' : false , ... > $ UserX 'reset' cloudA | (deviceB)
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('owner' : nils , ...) , ... > < deviceB | 'online' : false , ... > .
